text:
Emily Chen: Quick run summary from today's quant sweep for rwd-7b-v2 across us-west1 / eu-central1 / ap-northeast1. TL;DR: INT8 and FP8 give the largest token/sec wins, but regional kernel/driver differences matter. Details and numbers below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Raj Patel: Nice. which eval sets and metrics did you use?

Emily Chen: eval sets: qa-open-10k (closed-book QA), summarization-2k, and lm-perp-5k (heldout). metrics: QA F1, Rouge-L, and perplexity. baseline = fp16 (our current prod).

Mara Gomez: Share the p50/p95 and throughput numbers? small table is fine.

Emily Chen: pasted raw numbers from the bench-runner here (shortened). note: all numbers are for 128-token responses unless noted.

```
# Kernel set: flash-attn2 + fused-kv-cache
# Batch=1 (single request streaming), seq=128
# GPUs: A10G, A100-80GB, H100

GPU        | profile | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tokens/s | speedup vs fp16 | QA-F1 delta
-----------|---------|---------|---------|----------|------------------|------------
A10G       | fp16    | 220     | 480     | 580      | 1.0              | 0.0%
A10G       | int8    | 110     | 300     | 1250     | 2.15x            | -0.9%
A10G       | fp8     | 95      | 260     | 1450     | 2.5x             | -0.6%

A100-80GB  | fp16    | 95      | 210     | 1400     | 1.0              | 0.0%
A100-80GB  | int8    | 40      | 95      | 3200     | 2.29x            | -0.7%
A100-80GB  | fp8     | 35      | 80      | 3600     | 2.57x            | -0.3%

H100       | fp16    | 72      | 150     | 1850     | 1.0              | 0.0%
H100       | int8    | 18      | 40      | 7000     | 3.78x            | -1.1%
H100       | fp8     | 16      | 36      | 7800     | 4.22x            | -0.5%
```

Emily Chen: Notes: A10G shows decent INT8 gains but slightly larger quality drop. H100 INT8 requires the mma-int8-kernel-v3 + cuda 12.2 drivers; we couldn't reproduce H100 INT8 perf in ap-northeast1 because the region image has cuda 12.0 currently.

Raj Patel: So region difference is driver/kernel availability, not model variance. Any perf-bot artifacts?

perf-bot: bench-runner artifact uploaded -> https://perf.internal/bench/1752345678 (contains full logs, raw traces, and perf counters)

Mara Gomez: For production, what's your recommendation for routing and capacity sizing?

Emily Chen: Short answer:
- Default: fp16 for latency-sensitive flows (p95 SLA target 200ms).
- High-throughput tier: prefer fp8 where supported (H100/A100) with canary for QA regression.
- Fallback: on nodes/regions without kernel support, route to fp16.

Capacity sizing snippet (rules of thumb):
```
# target: 100 RPS of 128-token responses (approx 12.8k tokens/s)
# choose GPU and concurrency based on tokens/s from table
# Example: using A100-80GB with int8 (3200 tokens/s per GPU)
concurrency_needed = ceil(12800 / 3200) = 4 GPUs
# add 20% headroom -> 5 GPUs
```

Emily Chen: For H100 with fp8 (7800 tokens/s), concurrency_needed = ceil(12800/7800)=2 GPUs -> 3 with headroom. Also factor in burst and model context growth (longer responses).

Tony Li: How about batching and kernel choices? you mentioned flash-attn2 vs triton kernels.

Emily Chen: We tested three kernel stacks: flash-attn2 (best for causal gen on H100/A100), triton-fused-attn (more stable across GPUs but slightly slower for int8), and mma-int8-kernel-v3 (gives best INT8 throughput on H100). For production: use flash-attn2+mma-int8 on H100 if drivers match; fallback to triton-fused-attn on heterogeneous fleets.

Raj Patel: Quality regressions look small but nonzero. any per-task breakdown? e.g., summarization vs QA?

Emily Chen: yes. summarization (Rouge-L) dropped ~0.2% for fp8, ~0.6% for int8. perplexity increased ~1.5% for int8 on lm-perp set. QA F1 had the biggest sensitivity (~0.9% on A10G INT8). I recommend adding prompt-aware thresholds: allow int8 for short-answer flows but keep fp16 for long-form/chain-of-thought chains.

Mara Gomez: rollout plan?

Emily Chen: proposed rollout:
1) Canary 2% traffic in us-west1 on A100 and H100 where drivers are up-to-date. monitor QA-F1 and user-facing error rates.
2) Expand to 25% if no QA regressions >1.0% and latency p95 is stable.
3) Cross-region: ensure ap-northeast1 images get cuda 12.2 and mma kernel before enabling INT8 there.

Emily Chen: Example route config we plan to push (console / infra):
```
route:
  model: rwd-7b-v2
  allowed_quant_profiles: ["fp16","fp8","int8"]
  region_policies:
    us-west1: prefer: ["int8","fp8","fp16"]
    eu-central1: prefer: ["fp8","int8","fp16"]
    ap-northeast1: prefer: ["fp16","fp8"] # int8 disabled until driver update
  rollout:
    canary: 0.02
    step: 0.25
    metric: qa_f1_delta
    threshold: 0.01
```

Tony Li: Sounds reasonable. add a CI gate to reject int8 builds if loom-evals show >1% QA-F1 drop.

Emily Chen: Yup added to backlog. Filed JIRA RWD-1372 for the gate and RWD-1373 to coordinate ap-northeast1 image update.

Mara Gomez: Thanks. can you upload the CSV of the raw numbers to the shared drive? i'll take a pass for cost modeling.

Emily Chen: done -> https://shared.internal/rwd/bench/rwd-7b-v2-quant-1752345678.csv

Raj Patel: Great work. let's sync after 24h once we have canary metrics. :rocket:

Emily Chen: tuned and will follow up with a short runbook for ops (warmup, cache priming, monitoring alerts).
